description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - The Merchant Shipping (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers) Regulations 2016 and the Merchant Shipping (Minimum Safe Manning) Regulations 2016 that shall Come into force on 04.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes new legal/regulatory frameworks for training, certification, and watchkeeping standards for seafarers, implementing an international convention. The content focuses entirely on creating new regulatory requirements and compliance standards rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
